releases.name: SpeedRunners 2: King of Speed
releases.summary:
SpeedRunners 2: King of Speed is a fast-paced competitive platformer and a sequel to one of the most beloved indie games of the 2010s. Pick a character of your choice from a vibrant cast of eccentric superheroes, both returning and new, and face off against your rivals in frenetic running races for up to 8 players per lobby, locally or online.

The original multiplayer gameplay formula of SpeedRunners is timeless, unofficially dubbed as the ‘Mario Kart of 2D platformers’. With the sequel, our goal is to carefully bring this unique ‘SpeedRunners feel’ into the new era without compromising on the depth and fluidity of the movement system while still keeping it easy to grasp. On top of that, King of Speed introduces vibrant high-definition graphics and improved netcode.

releases.name: BioEden
releases.summary:
Welcome to BioEden, a cozy management game where you will build a self-sustaining network of structures, all working in harmony to bring extinct animals back to life. As a Keeper, you have been entrusted by the Cosmic Collective to bring life back to a planet quietly waiting to be healed. 

Upon your arrival, search for debris sites scattered across the land, they are the foundation of your journey. Recycle them into resources, and use those to build the base of your network: a solar energy system to generate electricity, and a water system to distribute it across all your buildings. Connect them together, weave a network across the land, and manage the supply and demand for every structure you create.

But plan with care. Each addition to your planet consumes resources, draws on energy, and nudges pollution upward. Find the balance between creation, exploration, and restraint, to accomplish the very mission that brought you here.

releases.name: Marsupilami 2 - Salsa Palombia
releases.summary: A strange melody has swept across Palombia… and suddenly every animal starts dancing wildly, throwing the jungle into total chaos! Behind this rhythmic madness lurks the Mummy Queen, back from the Underworld with her crew to deliver a cursed concert with devastating effects. To restore peace to the jungle, take control of the three young Marsus, each with their own signature ability. Twister shoots through the air with a turbo glide, Hope leaps forward with an energetic spinning jump, and Punch bounces with powerful force to knock aside anything in his path! Switch instantly from one Marsu to another to unleash their powers and chain together stylish moves. And for even more fun, share the adventure with a friend thanks to local co‑op mode! From the Jungle to the City, from Snowy Mountains to the mysterious Underworld…explore four enchanting worlds packed with surprises, challenges, and unique gameplay mechanics. Beyond the main adventure, take on the Flow Mode, a speed-focused challenge where you must complete a series of trials without dying to prove your skills! And for even more fun, challenge your friends in competitive dojos.

releases.name: The Blood of Dawnwalker
releases.summary:
Bringing together a talented team of developers, including members of the core team behind one of the most acclaimed games of all time - The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt along with its expansions, Rebel Wolves’ first title is a dark fantasy narrative sandbox, AAA action-RPG set in medieval Europe.

This brand-new IP is aimed at mature audiences and is powered by Unreal Engine 5.

releases.name: AereA
releases.summary:
AereA is a music themed Action RPG in which you play as one of Great Maestro Guido's disciples and explore Aezir; a floating island that was broken into pieces. Your mission is to find and return the nine primordial instruments to restore balance and peace to the world.

You have to find your way through all parts of the scattered islands; complete quests, solve puzzles, defeat bosses and discover the truth behind the islands. Will you be able to return the nine primordial instruments?

Play as Wolff the Harp-Archer, Jacques the Cello-Knight, Jules the Lute-Mage, Claude the Trumpet-Gunner, or team up with your friends in local co-op. Collect Music Sheets to learn new skills and customize your weapons to your play style.

releases.name: Wiz (1985)
releases.summary: Open Face Chinese Poker with Fantasyland is the most exciting poker game you’ll ever play.  This variation of Chinese Poker is simple to learn and will have you hooked in no time.  Play multiple games online simultaneously and chat with your opponents from anywhere in the world. Experience the excitement through the 3 modes offered in this app; Practice mode where you square up against our computer opponent, Pass and Play mode where you and your friend can battle on the same device or Play With Friends where you can invite anyone in the world to play over our private and secure server!  Download now to experience the game everyone is talking about!

releases.name: Keeper
releases.summary: Twisted Tic-Tac-ToeTic-Tac-Toe with a twist!Play against a friend or take on the computer in this strategic game inspired by the classic game of Tic-Tac-Toe.In Tic-Tac-Toe the goal is to obtain a row of 3. This game takes it to the next level. Players try to make rows of 3, 4, 5, or 6 earning points with each row that they make. Players alternate turns until the board is full. At this point a winner is declared based on the number of points scored in each round. In the game, players have 2 choices. To block or to score. Which is better? That is for you to find out.

releases.name: Angeline Era
releases.summary:
Every level is hidden in plain sight in this nonlinear 3D Action-Adventure game! Travel a vast country's unmarked overworld in search of the next challenging fight, humorous encounter, or mysterious landscape. YOU decide what you discover next in this world of Fae, Humans and Angels!

The Angel's mothership, Throne, lays dormant behind a fierce storm. To reach it, unlock its secrets, and usher in the future, you must explore the land of Era and survive its trap-filled ruins, primordial forests, treacherous mountains, mines, and more! Overcome intense battles and hilarious hazards in this tale of betrayal, haunting lore, and fruitless yearning.

releases.name: Super Woden Rally Edge
releases.summary:
The spin-off of the acclaimed Super Woden saga, blending classic arcade essence with great depth and a genuine love for car culture.

With a unique personality, Rally Edge takes you back to an era where fun goes beyond realism.

releases.name: Moonlighter 2: The Endless Vault
releases.summary:
Will is back to business in this Action-RPG with roguelike elements!

With no coin to your name, you and the other townsfolk find yourselves stranded in the distant village of Tresna. Now, it’s up to you to get back on your feet and turn your humble shop into the beating heart of the village’s wealth. 

Explore dangerous dungeons, gather relics, sell them, and reinvest in your friends’ establishments. Unlock new weapons, armor, shop decorations, and - more importantly - restore hope that things can one day turn around.

releases.name: Monuments Renovator
releases.summary: Monuments Renovator is a game in which you play the role of a professional monument renovator. You choose from among the world's greatest monuments, restore them to their former glory and learn about history and architecture.You organize, fill and paint. You rebuild collapsed walls, renew old frescoes. Do everything to bring the monument back to its glory days.Improve your skills in using various tools, use different materials and renovation will become more efficient and more enjoyable.Take care of the details when you work. Check the plans for the correctness of your work and make sure that the renovation proceeds in accordance with the project.The last stage is interior furnishings. Make the famous building functional as well.Ready for the next challenge? The next great monuments are already waiting for your help.

releases.name: Crimson Moon
releases.summary: Crimson Moon is a Gothic High Renaissance action-adventure RPG built around intense, replayable missions that blend brutal precision with deep character progression. Set in the besieged city of Gildenarch, players hack and slash their way through cathedrals, battlements, and shadowed districts overrun by demons, vampires, and undead gods. Players can venture alone or bring a friend in optional co-op as they wield angelic power and fight back the Infernal Legion.

releases.name: Lady Death Demonicron
releases.summary: WordZone is het nieuwe Nederlandse online-woordspel, waarmee je je Facebook-vrienden en andere tegenstanders kunt verslaan en topscorer kunt worden!Het gaat erom hoe handig en creatief je woorden legt.Je maakt daarbij gebruik van de Van Dale Taalspelwoordenlijst, de meest uitgebreide woordenlijst Nederlands, speciaal ontwikkeld voor taalspelletjes!Spelkenmerken:• ELO-rating en topscorelijsten• Je speelt tegen je Facebook-vrienden en je kunt je gewonnen en verloren partijen bijhouden• Je speelt tegen willekeurige spelers op je eigen niveau• Je kunt tijdens het spel chatten met je vrienden en tegenstanders• Van Dale Taalspelwoordenlijst, de meest uitgebreide woordenlijst Nederlands, speciaal ontwikkeld voor taalspelletjes• Omvangrijke woordenlijsten in veel andere talen• Woorden die niet in de woordenlijst staan, mogen door je tegenstander goedgekeurd worden• Er zijn 5 verschillende borden: Standaard, Random, Blanco, Blue Heaven en Diagonale Bonus• Je kunt een onbeperkt aantal partijen tegelijk spelenBeschikbare talen:• Deens (Gyldendal)• Duits• Engels (internationaal)• Engels (Amerikaans)• Faeröers• Fins• Frans• Groenlands• IJslands• Italiaans• Nederlands (Van Dale)• Noors (Bokmål)• Noors (Nynorsk)• Pools• Portugees (Brazilië)• Portugees (Portugal)• Roemeens• Spaans• ZweedsSpelregels:• WordZone is een online-woordspel voor 2 spelers.• Je kiest een van je vrienden als tegenstander of je laat de app iemand vinden op je eigen spelniveau.• Je krijgt 7 letters met een verschillende waarde. Je wint punten door daarmee woorden te leggen op een bord met vakjes. Eigennamen en de meeste afkortingen mogen niet.• Degene met de meeste punten heeft gewonnen!WordZone is ontwikkeld in samenwerking met vooraanstaande Europese woordenboekenmakers, zodat je de beste woordenlijsten tot je beschikking hebt. Er komen regelmatig nieuwe talen bij!

releases.name: Serious Sam: Shatterverse
releases.summary: Serious Sam: Shatterverse is a co-op roguelite FPS for 1 - 5 players. Blast through shifting universes, stack wild boons, bend the rules with run modifiers, and hunt Mental's deadliest forces. Fall fast. Come back louder.

releases.name: Wishing Well Simulator
releases.summary: [h2]You cannot move. You cannot speak. You can only choose.[/h2]You are a stone wishing well in a small seaside town. People lean over your edge, toss a coin, and whisper what they want most. Granting is your only voice — and your water is not endless.[h2]Every wish has a price[/h2]Eight townspeople return to you, day after day, for eight days. The merchant asks for a horse; days later he buys the field that fed the girl who greets you every morning. The game never blames you. It only shows you what you did — in the same faces, in the same square, one day later.[h2]Features[/h2][list][*] 119 handwritten events across 8 days — each one someone's wish, or its consequence[*] 8 characters whose fates intertwine: what you give one, you quietly take from another[*] 4 endings, decided by the kind of well you chose to be[*] The town remembers: choices persist and come back as props, lines and faces[*] Two buttons: grant or refuse. (And one more, to skip.)[*] A living square from dawn to dusk — visitors arrive with the sun[*] One run: 70–80 minutes. Seeing everything: about four runs.[*] Full controller support · playable in 22 languages[/list][h2]Who is the well when the water runs low?[/h2]Some wishes feed your depths; some drain them. Hold everything back and be forgotten. Give everything away and watch the town devour itself. Four ends of the same rope — and none of them is called "right".

releases.name: Tank Odyssey
releases.summary: Enter fast-paced tank arenas where sharp movement and quick decisions are the keys to survival. Fight relentless enemies, switch between four distinct weapons and take on a new challenge in every level - hunt for hidden keys, capture zones, complete time trials and more!Battle through 20 increasingly difficult levels across the Arcade, Void, Paper and Distort arenas, then test your skills in four objective-free Endless modes. Stay mobile, master every weapon and survive the chaos in Tank Odyssey.

releases.name: Vampire Survivors: Legacy of the Blood Moon
releases.summary:
In ancient times, Saint Baal'Thasar had a vision of paradise, lit by a bright, red moon. And so he founded the Order of the Red Moon, to lead people to a land of eternal life. The myth says that Baal'Thasar found his paradise during a pilgrimage, and so never returned.

Having lost its leader, the Order shattered and many fringe sects were born from its remnants. Today, members of one of the most unscrupulous cults, Clan Bloodmoon, embarks on a journey to follow in Baal'Thasar's footsteps...

releases.name: Once Alive
releases.summary: The famous Reversi game, with awesome backgrounds from Fermoeditore books illustrations.

releases.name: Quiz & Learn: Food & Drink
releases.summary: Quizture, guess by pictures! Discover movies and have fun at the same time. Are you bored with the classic guessing games that just show a picture of a logo, a flag or a movie? Quizture is a brand new concept of guessing game where you will have to interact with different images to find the answers! Are you ready? Just download it now and discover how different and funny a trivia game can be!Quizture Movie Edition is a fun and interactive quiz game that challenges players to recognize hit movies of all genres: thriller, drama, comedy, sci-fi... Are you able to guess the title of a movie just by looking at a snapshot?MORE THAN 250 BRILLIANT MOVIES, and there are more to come!FIVE DIFFERENT GAME MODES.RANK HIGH AND BEAT YOUR FRIENDS.Show how much you know about movies and become a top player. Compare scores with your friends!HINTSStuck on a movie? Don't give up! Use bombs to unlock hints.DON'T STOP LEARNINGMaximize your movie knowledge. Get instant access to extended information about the movie you have just guessed.SHAREUse a little help from your friends to unlock levels, find answers and much more by sharing on Facebook, Twitter and other social networks. www.quizture.com

releases.name: Iridio
releases.summary:
Seized by criminals, the island designated for your research needs your help.

Join Yatziri and the Wazhari tribe to liberate their hostages, explore hidden secrets, craft essential items and weapons, and strategically use fire and water in challenging puzzles and life-or-death battles for survival.
